description: A complete managed C# reimplementation of curl and libcurl for .NET 10: no native libcurl, native-AOT ready, behaves like curl 8.22.0. An MCP server that runs curl for AI agents: Curl, the drop-in C# replacement for the curl command-line tool, served over standard input and output.
title: Surly Curl MCP server
